'''2007 New Jersey State Championship Greg Hodur LS Mind What You Have Learned''' was the Light Side constructed list played by [[Greg Hodur]] at [[2007 New Jersey State Championship]].

== Deck info ==

* '''Starting Card:''' {{CardLink|Mind What You Have Learned / Save You It Can|SE-L-mindwhatyouhavelearned.gif}}
* '''Name on sheet:''' HoduR
* '''Deck name:''' Biggity Beats
* '''Format:''' [[Premiere - Original VS12]]
